title: Paintbrush with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- brush handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='10' width='14' height='46' rx='5' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <rect x='46' y='12' width='4' height='42' rx='2' fill='#f5c56a'/>
  <!-- ferrule -->
  <rect x='41' y='54' width='20' height='10' rx='3' fill='#cfd8e3'/>
  <rect x='43' y='55' width='5' height='8' rx='2' fill='#eef3f8'/>
  <!-- bristles -->
  <path d='M42 63 L60 63 L58 82 Q55 92 51 92 Q47 92 44 82 Z' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <path d='M45 65 L51 65 L50 86 Q48 91 47 86 Z' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <path d='M52 65 L57 65 L56 84 Q54 90 53 84 Z' fill='#b07a45'/>
  <!-- paint blob on bristles -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='86' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#ff9fc0'/>
  <!-- face on ferrule/handle area -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='40' rx='3.2' ry='3.6' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='40' rx='3.2' ry='3.6' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='1.2' fill='#9fe8ff'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff7aa8'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff7aa8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 48 Q50 55 57 48' stroke='#2a1a4a' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little highlight on handle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='2' fill='#ffe4a8'/>
  <!-- paint drip -->
  <path d='M63 63 Q66 66 65 71 Q64 74 62 71 Q61 68 63 63' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
</svg>
